registry.hintLocal: The site doesn’t know which public registry to use yet. If you’re setting this up: follow the README, or open the page once with your registry address after ?contract= in the address bar (long text starting with 0x).
registry.hintProduction: The live site needs the registry address in your deployment settings (see README). Alternatively, open the page once with ?contract= and the address in the URL.

trust.yellowNewerTitle: Site version is newer than the “latest stable” you configured — check release notes before trusting.
trust.yellowOlderTitle: This stable line is older than the newest one. Check upgrade notes and trust assumptions.
trust.greenTitle: Site version matches the current stable line (≥1.0).

spec.legacy: Registry is too old — this interface cannot use it.
spec.v02: Older registry rules: you only pay network fees; optional public link to your file; museums/experts have more room to work.
spec.v03: Current rules (v0.3): transfer ownership, revoke a passport, more images, expert/museum concern flags, unlink child institutions.

disclosure.odpassPara: On Verify, you can open a .odpass file from your device (it’s a ZIP). It contains passport.json; the page checks it against the public record. Extra files live under originals/. Hashing and previews run in your browser — files are not uploaded to this site. Older bundle layouts still work.
disclosure.readPara: Lookups use the main registry first. If there’s no match, you can fall back to older registry addresses from settings — useful when data moved between deployments.
disclosure.semverLte1: Site version 0.x means experimental builds (🚩 red flag). Stable releases start at 1.0. If several stable lines exist, an older major can be a yellow flag — read the release notes.
disclosure.semverGt1: 0.x = red flag. Major {L} (latest stable) = green. Majors 1…{prevMajorsEnd} = yellow — older stable lines; check migration. Small updates under the same major stay green while that major is current.
